preserved_prior_findings.frozen_target_primitive_class: generation-keyed idempotent effect API with generation-correlated authoritative committed-effect visibility

preserved_prior_findings.checkpoint_replay_envelope: Candidate carries parent_blob and unique slice_id; stale or duplicate predecessor checkpoints are rejected by parent_blob equality plus repository CAS and exact readback.
preserved_prior_findings.external_crash_window_impossibility: Repository checkpoint ordering/readback alone cannot distinguish no-accept from accept-no-ack histories after a crash; retry risks duplicate and suppress risks omission.

minimal_external_effect_contract.G: Stable generation-scoped request identity k(g), distinct across generations and bound to intended payload digest d(g); conflicting payload under the same key is rejected.
minimal_external_effect_contract.I: Acceptance is idempotent for k(g),d(g); same-generation replays produce at most one logical external effect and preserve one logical result.
minimal_external_effect_contract.V: Recovery has authoritative generation- and payload-correlated visibility of committed effect state/result, or equivalent atomic coupling whose replay semantics supply that authority.

bounded_leaf_result.tested_scope: Deterministic source-free local reasoning over the exact predecessor reasoning STATE under the frozen SHA authority tuple. No public source, target call, external effect, O/downstream/other-worker semantics, shared ledger, legacy research, protected/manual execution, hosted compute, finite quota, or scheduler mutation.

observable_alphabet.submit: submit(k,d) -> ack_committed(r) | ack_pending | ack_lost | reject_conflict | transport_error
observable_alphabet.query: query(k,d) -> committed(r) | pending | not_committed | not_found | payload_conflict | visibility_unavailable | visibility_ambiguous
observable_alphabet.replay: replay(k,d) -> same_result(r) | pending | reject_conflict | second_distinct_effect | different_result(r2)
observable_alphabet.cross_generation: query_or_replay(k_old,d_old while g_new active) -> old_result_only | isolated_not_found | contaminates_current | suppresses_current

states.S0_PREPARED: Durable current generation g has one k(g),d(g) before any effect attempt.
states.S1_SUBMIT_UNKNOWN: A submit occurred but acceptance/commit is not yet authoritatively known, including lost acknowledgment.
states.S2_UNCOMMITTED_OBSERVED: Authoritative observation says pending/not_committed/not_found, but a delayed original may still exist unless the primitive provides a stronger final-negative guarantee.
states.S3_COMMITTED: Authoritative V for the exact k(g),d(g) returns committed(result=r). This is the only success state allowed to advance the workflow.
states.S4_REPLAY_STABLE: Same-key replay returns/preserves the same logical result r without a second logical effect; operationally equivalent to S3 for recovery.
states.F_G_IDENTITY: Generation identity separation, payload binding, or old-generation isolation is violated.
states.F_I_DUPLICATE: Same-key replay or delayed-original race creates a second logical effect or a different logical result.
states.F_V_VISIBILITY: Committed state/result cannot be authoritatively resolved for the exact generation/payload or visibility is only stale/cache-like.
states.F_ADVANCE: Workflow advances from local checkpoint, ack, pending/not_found, or mismatched-generation evidence instead of exact authoritative committed evidence.
states.U_UNRESOLVED: No structural failure is observed, but one or more P1-P8 predicates cannot be established from the candidate's exposed semantics.

transitions.to: S3_COMMITTED if ack is itself authoritative committed evidence; otherwise S1_SUBMIT_UNKNOWN

transitions.guard: never advance; retry only with the exact same k,d and only if I is structurally guaranteed

transitions.event: same k with d2!=d accepted or query binds to wrong payload
k(g1)=k(g2) within correctness horizon or old result suppresses/satisfies current generation
advance current workflow on exact k,d,r evidence

predicate_mapping.P1_same_generation_key_stability: Check all retries/replays for g expose the same durable k(g); a changed key is F_G_IDENTITY.
predicate_mapping.P2_cross_generation_separation: Check k(g1)!=k(g2) for distinct generations across the claimed correctness horizon; alias/reuse is F_G_IDENTITY.
predicate_mapping.P3_payload_binding: Check d is part of the authority relation and conflicting d2 under k is hard-rejected before a second effect; otherwise F_G_IDENTITY.
predicate_mapping.P4_idempotent_acceptance: Issue/consider same-key replay and delayed-original race; second effect or different logical result is F_I_DUPLICATE.
predicate_mapping.P5_authoritative_visibility: Require query/replay authority for exact k,d that governs visible effect state/result; cache-only or unavailable visibility is F_V_VISIBILITY.
predicate_mapping.P6_safe_noncommit_semantics: pending/not_committed/not_found never authorizes advancement or a fresh key; same-key retry is safe only because P4 holds, unless the primitive documents an authoritative final-negative state.
predicate_mapping.P7_commit_gated_advancement: Only S3/S4 may advance; any ack-only/local-checkpoint/pending/mismatched-generation advancement is F_ADVANCE.
predicate_mapping.P8_generation_correlated_replay: Old-generation query/replay may return only old-generation evidence and must neither satisfy nor suppress current g; contamination is F_G_IDENTITY.

candidate_check_procedure: C1 establish G first: durable same-generation key stability, cross-generation nonaliasing horizon, and payload binding. If any fail, verdict=REJECT.
C2 establish I: same-key replay plus delayed-original race must remain one logical effect with one stable result. If duplicate/different result is possible, verdict=REJECT.

C3 establish V: exact k,d recovery visibility must be authoritative for committed state/result or supplied by equivalent atomic replay semantics. If only cache/best-effort/local evidence exists, verdict=REJECT.
C4 run lost-ack recovery: after ambiguous submit, query/replay must deterministically converge to S3/S4 without generating a second effect and without advancing from S1/S2. Otherwise verdict=REJECT.
C5 run generation-isolation checks: old-generation replay/result cannot satisfy, suppress, or mutate current generation. Otherwise verdict=REJECT.

C6 verdict=PASS only when P1-P8 are structurally established and every M1/M2/M3/M5/M6 failure row is impossible or rejected while M0/M4/M7 positive conditions hold. If a required property is merely unexposed rather than contradicted, verdict=UNRESOLVED, never PASS.
bounded_leaf_result.decision_invariant: The verifier is conservative: authoritative committed evidence for the exact generation/payload is sufficient to advance one effect; every other observation either remains retry-safe under the same key, rejects the candidate, or leaves it unresolved. No local repository checkpoint can stand in for external-effect visibility.
